name: backBox
meaning: PROPERTY_DOORLEVEL_IDBOXBACK (prop 0); standing in it means Ralph approaches the door from the back, which selects the next level up. Null-checked at 0x4b3ee7 before the six-way containment test.

name: state
meaning: 0 uninitialised (Update starts the idle animation and moves to 1), 1 idle, 3 walk-through requested by MSG_USE, 5 walk-through playing. Only 0, 3 and 5 are dispatched, so 1 is the idle sink.

name: levelNumber
meaning: PROPERTY_DOORLEVEL_LEVELNUMBER (prop 4), a disc level index 0..17 indexed into g_levelLabels. It is also the render gate: a door with 0 here is never drawn. Read with movsx everywhere.

name: enteredFromBack
meaning: Set by MSG_QUERY_ACTION when Ralph stands inside backBox; with it set AND levelNumber non-zero, Update writes levelNumber+1 as the level to load, so one door object serves two adjacent levels. The banner path increments a LOCAL copy with no levelNumber check, so the two can disagree at level 0.

name: wolfFacingDoor
meaning: Set by MSG_USE to 1 when the heading from the door to Ralph is within 0x400 (90 degrees) of the door's own facing (`setl` at 0x4b413e); picks the walk-through animation pair 5/6 instead of 4/2.
